newsitem.title: USA: HP cuts notebook PC prices.
newsitem.headline: HP cuts notebook PC prices.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co. Monday cut list prices on the HP OmniBook 5500 notebook PC series for the second time in two months, by up to 15 percent.
HP also reduced prices on hard-drives for the series by 36 percent to 45 percent. Random access memory expansion modules for the computers now cost 36 percent to 41 percent less than before.

HP said retail prices are expected to start at $2,840 for the HP OmniBook 5500 CS 5/100 notebook PC model 810, a 100 megahertz Pentium-based system. Retail prices for a 133 megahertz Pentium-based system are expected to start at $4,840 for the HP OmniBook 5500 CT 5/133 notebook PC model 1350.
On July 9, Palo Alto, Calif.-based HP cut prices of the OmniBook 5500 notebook PC series by up to 17 percent.
Hewlett-Packard stock rose 87.5 cents to $44.50 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
